relations.myth: Jonah’s two commissions to preach against Nineveh
relations.note: YHWH twice commissions Jonah, who eventually delivers the warning to Nineveh.

relations.myth: Storm and confinement following Jonah’s flight
relations.note: YHWH sends the storm and appoints the fish after Jonah flees.
YHWH hears Jonah’s prayer and commands the fish to expel him.

relations.myth: Plant, worm, wind, and lesson about Nineveh
relations.note: YHWH uses appointed creatures and weather to challenge Jonah’s lack of pity.

relations.myth: Jonah frightens Leviathan beneath the cosmic sea
relations.note: Jonah displays Abraham’s covenantal seal, drives Leviathan away, and vows its future capture.
Jesus invokes Jonah as a sign, connecting his ordeal with resurrection and Nineveh’s repentance.

relations.myth: Three days in fish and earth
relations.note: Matthew compares Jonah’s three days in the fish with the Son of Man’s burial.
